plainTranslation: Sharp thinking and decisive drive flow together. The Mercury person thinks fast, the Mars person acts on it cleanly; strong for problem-solving and momentum. An easy, stimulating working rhythm. Lean on it for projects and decisions.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
You can be direct with each other without creating unnecessary conflict. Conversations tend to move quickly, honestly, and toward a solution. This person helps you say what you mean, and you help them do the same.

At its best, this aspect creates straightforward communication. Problems get discussed instead of avoided. Decisions get made instead of endlessly debated. There is a natural ability to challenge each other without taking it personally.

The strength of this connection is the way honesty can move between you without getting stuck. Conversations have a way of clearing the air. What needs to be said often finds its way to the surface, making it easier to address what matters instead of circling around it.

The gift here is the reminder that truth can be a catalyst. When you are willing to meet each other with openness and sincerity, insight becomes action, and understanding creates momentum.

Use the honesty while it is flowing. This connection works best when what gets said out loud turns into something you actually act on.
